executive_summary: Three to four sentences. Lead with years of experience and the scope you own, then the outcomes you are accountable for, then the channels or tooling you work in. Use real numbers only.

work_experience.title: Your Title
bullets: Open with the action and the scope you owned, then the measured result. Shape: Managed $X/month across <channels>, driving +Y% <metric> while reducing <cost metric> by Z%.
One specific, verifiable number per bullet beats several vague claims.
